name: CaseLayoutOnNonFlexContainer
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "layout-on-non-flex-container" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: align-items / justify-content authored on a container whose display is NOT flex (here display: table)
